description: Free automatic rigging tool that turns 3D character models into fully rigged characters
##: The product page's download button serves AccuRig_Webinstaller.exe, a 1.1 MiB NSIS downloader stub that fetches the real setup at run time; the manifest skips the stub and pins the versioned full installer published in the same bucket.

latest.yml is the electron-updater feed for the app: it names AccuRIG_Setup_<version>.exe and publishes the sha512 of each release. checkver and autoupdate.hash both read it, so no page scraping and no re-download of the 400 MiB installer on update.

The setup is an NSIS-3 wrapper: 7-Zip yields $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z (a flat Electron payload with AccuRIG.exe at the root), Uninstall AccuRIG.exe and uninstallerIcon.ico. The bundled VCRuntime and DirectX installers under $PLUGINSDIR\ActoreCore are not used; installer.script expands app-64.7z and drops the NSIS leftovers.
Only a win-x64 build is published and the executable requests asInvoker, so no admin rights are needed.

User data stays outside the app directory: the app redirects userData to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Reallusion\ActorCore AccuRIG, uses a Reallusion folder in Documents, and keeps the electron-updater cache in %LOCALAPPDATA%; nothing under the app dir needs persisting.
The top-level hash is the sha512 from latest.yml, verified against the downloaded installer.
